description: This file defines a Symfony console command class 'RunMigrationClassCommand' for executing database migrations in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for configuration and executing a specified migration class, with validation and environment setup.

classes.name: RunMigrationClassCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command class for running specified migration classes within OrangeHRM's development tools.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the command with description, help message, and required argument 'className'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command, validating application installation, migration class, initializing environment, and running the migration.
